packageRules.description: Only Docker Hub exposes release timestamps. GHCR/Quay/ECR tags have none, so with the Renovate 42 default (minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour=timestamp-required) their updates stay in 'Pending Status Checks' forever instead of ever getting a PR.

The ansible-galaxy manager sets packageName to the full clone URL for git-sourced collections, which the github-tags datasource cannot resolve ('no-result'). depName is already github.com/owner/repo, so strip the host to get the owner/repo that github-tags expects.
sdr-enthusiasts images publish no semver tags; their immutable releases are numbered latest-build-<n>.
